solver_contract.input: requested command, planned phase/feet, nominal centred-COM mass and known payload only
solver_contract.basis: 32-knot periodic cubic B-spline; C2 steady cycle
solver_contract.constraints: three planned stance loads >=.1 N during .80--1 swing; raw scheduled loads >=0 all phases; coefficients within +/-15 mm
solver_contract.limitations: Constraints are at zero attitude after startup. Existing half-angle attitude compensation and linear startup ramp remain unchanged; no true COM or dynamic feasibility claim.

predictions: Backward negative nominal stance loads disappear before clipping.
Unexpected loaded-stance contact losses and velocity ripple decrease without higher slew/saturation demand.
Forward may lose useful stabilizing motion; this is an outcome to test with the same reference definition.

results.screen_note: The screen excludes only duration; full qualification still requires all original checks.

telemetry_all.phase_note: Phase bins use the held command phase; contact sample times use actual physics time since reset settling.

telemetry_steady.phase_note: Phase bins use the held command phase; contact sample times use actual physics time since reset settling.

randomization.thermal_model: estimated first-order proxy, not a identified winding model

results.geometry_note: Only support reference changes. Requested/scored command stays original; geometric vx/vy gain 1.15, original yaw, clearance timing, centred-COM solver and sensor/motor settings are inherited. Nominal zero-attitude feasibility is not a dynamic guarantee.
